mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.price AS price, g.status AS goodsStatus, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, bu.username AS buyerName, o.seller_id AS sellerId, su.username AS sellerName, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, o.cancel_time AS cancelTime, o.create_time AS createTime, g.campus AS campus, g.location AS location, gi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM orders o LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.goods_id LEFT JOIN `user` bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` su ON o.seller_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON gi.image_id = ( SELECT image_id FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = o.goods_id ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC LIMIT 1 )
